item.title: GOP lawmaker says he’s leaving the Republican Party and will serve as an independent
item.description: Rep. Kevin Kiley of California says he’s dropping his Republican Party affiliation to serve as an independent. Kiley said the change will take effect immediately. The two-term congressman faces a tough reelection battle following the redrawing of California’s congressional boundaries. item.title: FAA briefly grounds all JetBlue flights after request from airline
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration briefly grounded all JetBlue flights due to a request from the airline, the agency said in a notice posted to its website early Tuesday morning.
